name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Judge blocks Trump's latest effort to narrow birthright citizenship
changes.summary: A federal judge has temporarily blocked a Trump executive order that would prevent certain people from automatically becoming U.S. citizens at birth.

changes.title: Trump says he’ll campaign for Republicans in 35 races ahead of the midterms
changes.summary: The president said he’ll travel to help out GOP candidates in competitive midterm contests, including the Senate races in Alaska and Texas.

changes.title: States Sue Over Move to End to Federal Funds for Transgender Youth for Transition Care
changes.summary: The Trump administration wants to bar Medicaid and the Children’s Health Insurance Program from paying for gender-transition medication and surgery for transgender adolescents.

changes.title: Judge Blocks Trump’s Second Try to Restrict Birthright Citizenship
changes.summary: The ruling raised concerns that babies already defined as citizens by the Supreme Court could have their citizenship revoked under an order the president signed in August.

changes.title: Trump to Nominate Hung Cao as Navy Secretary
changes.summary: The announcement came amid a purge of leadership at the Pentagon and a stalling war effort against Iran.

changes.title: ICE detainee dies just hours after he was admitted into detention
changes.summary: Lianyong Wei's death marks the 57th death of an immigrant detainee held in the care of the government since the start of President Trump's second term. Twenty-four of those have occurred since Jan. 1. (Image credit: Heather Diehl).

changes.title: Kennedy Center Begins Removing Outdoor ‘Blue’ Sculpture
changes.summary: The towering artwork, added to the campus in 2019, was targeted for elimination after President Trump’s takeover of the center.

changes.title: On Trump’s Ballroom, Chief Justice Finds Himself in an Unusual Spot: In Dissent
changes.summary: Chief Justice John G. Roberts Jr. has been in the majority in divided cases more times than any other chief since 1953. But not this time.

changes.title: Trump’s Speed on the White House Ballroom Threatens to Outpace the Courts
changes.summary: In his breakneck construction of a grand ballroom and in many other initiatives, critics say, the president has tried to outrun judicial review.

changes.title: Iran claims U.S. struck wedding party as Trump navigates Pentagon leadership infighting
changes.summary: Iran is making fresh claims about the latest round of strikes in the region. This comes as U.S. military leaders navigate tensions sparked by resignations and recent firings. CBS News' Eleanor Watson has more.
